thesis: The graph is a derived, rebuildable index of git-tracked sources. Declared links and the human ledger are the only authoritative graph inputs; derived facts are recomputed; inferred facts are proposals that cannot satisfy a gate. A small trusted checker recomputes everything; extractors and agents are untrusted; the human decides.

determinism_rules: D-01 sorted iteration; total ORDER BY on every query
D-02 RFC 8785 subset for committed graph artefacts; no floats
D-03 explicit UTF-8 and LF I/O
D-04 no wall clock, time zone, uuid4, random, hostname or absolute path in artefacts; now is an explicit input
D-05 repo-relative POSIX paths only
D-06 CRLF folded before hashing or parsing; no raw byte offsets in identities
D-07 independent of PYTHONHASHSEED; no set iteration reaches output
D-08 locale-independent; ASCII-only code-facing forms
D-09 ban library-default orders (nx.condensation labels, graphlib order, os.listdir, unsorted glob)
D-10 no unrounded floats in committed files; fixed-iteration integer or Fraction ranking, quantised, ties by id
D-11 tool, grammar, Python minor and rule fingerprint in extractor record and cache key
D-12 domain-separated, length-safe hashing
D-13 hash methods versioned; change means new name plus re-baseline
D-14 partial extraction labelled partial; cannot PASS
D-15 missing prerequisite is NOT_RUN and absorbs PASS
D-16 external-process adapters sort output, accept only exact sentinel plus exit code, pin version and sha256
D-17 rebuild twice from a clean checkout: equal root hash
D-18 incremental equals clean after random edit sequences
D-19 permutation harness: file order, rule order, hash seed, TZ, LC_ALL, CWD, CRLF, threads, non-BMP
D-20 Windows and POSIX byte-identical goldens (POSIX not yet measured: NOT_RUN)
D-21 temp files inside .tmp/ with TMP and TEMP set
D-22 SARIF without GUIDs, timestamps or absolute paths; explicit columnKind
D-23 identity by id never by label; renames are explicit records
D-24 derived facts not committed unless a gate proves rebuild equality
